Shareholder register, incentive plans, document generation and e-signature

sections.title: About Factorial
texts: Factorial is an AI-powered business management platform for SMEs. It connects HR, finance and IT processes in a single piece of software: payroll, time tracking, absences, talent, expenses and devices. More than 17,000 companies use it and more than 1,500 people build it, with offices in Barcelona, Mexico City and São Paulo.
A team growing this fast needs an incentive plan that grows with it: every new hire with their letter, their signature and their units up to date.

sections.title: Why they chose Sttok
texts: 1. Ease of use of the platform.

uses.title: Invitation letters and signature

uses.title: Shareholder register
uses.text: Shareholders and incentive plan, always reconciled.
